title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-22
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Tight, high‑energy Greek run show with standout Deal, Tennessee Jed and Supplication performances, captured in excellent Charlie Miller sound‑board recording.
ai_review.review: The May 22‑1982 Greek shows are praised for their tight playing and memorable jams – especially the ripping Deal solo, the clever Tennessee Jed guitar story, and the flawless Lazy Lightnin’/Supplication sequence.  The Charlie Miller soundboard source provides crystal‑clear, balanced audio that lets every nuance shine, making this night a favorite among Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality indicate an excellent show with superb recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers cite Charlie Miller’s mix as fantastic, clear and well‑balanced; no complaints of dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as tight and well‑played throughout, with the first half of the second set highlighted; transitions flow smoothly despite some quirky intros.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His Deal solo is called "the most rippin" ever and his Tennessee Jed solo is praised as a long, clever story.
band_member_comments.Bob: A reviewer notes a strange intro to "Man Smart, Woman Smarter" where Bob seems momentarily lost before launching into the lyrics.
